tool_args.rationale: The supplied sink-coupled dual-horizon model failed fresh confirmation by a wide margin. The data are not marked as chaotic, so a targeted trajectory batch is preferable to immediate abstention and may identify the coupled-memory alternative.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It has no horizon dependence and cannot explain the observed sign reversal at long horizons.
The short-horizon outputs also vary strongly with sink gradient, which this law ignores.
The failed confirmation refutes the proposed dual-horizon law, but does not establish nonstationarity or refute all smooth mechanisms.
Selected: the batch can discriminate a coupled-memory ODE from the currently failed horizon law.
